sentences.text: Adrienne Eliza Houghton -LRB- née Bailon ; born October 24 , 1983 -RRB- is an American singer-songwriter , recording artist , actress , dancer and television personality .	née	Name at birth	singer-songwriter	singer-songwriter

Adrienne Bailon first became publicly known when she rose to fame as one of the founding members and singer of both 3LW -LRB- 1999 -- 2007 -RRB- and Disney 's The Cheetah Girls -LRB- 2003 -- 2008 -RRB- .	3LW	3LW	The Cheetah Girls	The Cheetah Girls (group)
Bailon recorded a debut solo album which was later shelved .
Since then , Bailon has stated that she plans to record a Spanish-language solo album .

Aside from her work in 3LW and The Cheetah Girls , Bailon went on to develop her own acting career with roles in The Cheetah Girls films , Coach Carter and the MTV film All You 've Got .	3LW	3LW	The Cheetah Girls	The Cheetah Girls (group)	Coach Carter	Coach Carter	MTV	MTV

Aside from her work in film , she has also guest starred in numerous television series including the Disney Channel series That 's So Raven and The Suite Life of Zack & Cody .	Disney Channel	Disney Channel	The Suite Life of Zack & Cody	The Suite Life of Zack & Cody

Bailon has established a solo music career , contributing two solo tracks , including `` What If '' , to The Cheetah Girls : One World soundtrack as well as the Confessions of a Shopaholic soundtrack , and numerous other guest musical ventures .	The Cheetah Girls	The Cheetah Girls (group)	Confessions of a Shopaholic	Confessions of a Shopaholic (film)

Bailon co-stars alongside television personality , model and actress Julissa Bermudez in their own reality series , Empire Girls : Julissa and Adrienne which airs on the Style Network .	Julissa Bermudez	Julissa Bermudez	reality series	Reality television	Style Network	Style (TV network)
Adrienne met Julissa on the set of the 2006 film All You 've Got .

Currently , Bailon is one of the hosts of syndicated talk show The Real along with former fellow Disney Channel star Tamera Mowry , Jeannie Mai , and Loni Love , which premiered on July 15 , 2013 .
